source_diagnosis: The form fake returned a select with count/evaluateAll/selectOption but no child locator. The production selectFirstOption requires select.locator(option).evaluateAll and invokes its DOM-option mapping callback. The prior inspection missed this nesting; the earlier details correction is retained byte-identically. No product or live browser failure is diagnosed.

Its namespace select exposes locator(option).evaluateAll, invokes the actual callback on realistic disabled/blank/zero/separator/usable option objects with trimmed text, and asserts selection of value 1. Other form methods and all original assertions remain.
